concept.title: Getting Started with X-Author for Contracts on Conga Platform

conbody.p: The X-Author for Contracts Advanced add-in works with both Conga CLM (On Salesforce) and Conga CLM (On the Conga Platform).
To access Conga Platform documentation, select Platform from the dropdown in the upper right menu. To access Salesforce documentation, select Salesforce from the dropdown menu.
To install X-Author for Contracts Advanced on the CLM Conga Platform, select one of the following topics:

link.linktext: Installing Production X-Author for Contracts Advanced Using Microsoft AppSource
Installing Production X-Author for Contracts on the Conga Platform Using Centralized Deployment Approach
Inserting X-Author Contracts Advanced Add-in for Contracts on the Conga Platform
